messages:
Evan: rolled helix-prefetcher v1.4 into a 12% canary at 11:03 UTC. early telemetry looks good, sharing the quick numbers and rollout plan.
Samira: paste the numbers pls
Evan: short summary (canary vs baseline):
```
workload           | median -> median | tail95 -> tail95 | tail99 -> tail99 | cost_per_1k_tokens
chat-short         | 36ms -> 26ms     | 145ms -> 120ms   | 300ms -> 255ms   | $1.00 -> $0.88
inference-13b-mid  | 68ms -> 49ms     | 410ms -> 345ms   | 830ms -> 720ms   | $1.00 -> $0.90
embed-small        | 29ms -> 21ms     | 110ms -> 92ms    | 230ms -> 195ms   | $1.00 -> $0.89
```
Leo: good drops. what's the change at a high level?
Evan: prefetcher now uses a tiny ML model to predict likely KV read patterns + aggressive dedupe. net effect: fewer cache-misses and less microbatch blocking for short sequences. more IO but less stall time.
Samira: worker impact? CPU/mem/IO?
Evan: CPU +6% on canary nodes, IO reads +9%, memory flat. queueing latency (median stall) down ~10ms across short-chat. bench-bot confirms reduced queue depth.
bench-bot: {"job":"helix-v1.4-canary-3103","duration_min":50,"queue_stall_reduction_ms":10}  
Samira: any error blips or customer-facing regressions?
Evan: ops-bot health checks: all green except one transient 504 during an unrelated regional gateway hiccup at 11:17; client retries handled it.
ops-bot: {"canary_id":"helix-3103","checks":{"latency":true,"errors":true},"notable_events":["504@11:17 - gateway hiccup"]}

Leo: rollback criteria?
Evan: auto rollback if tail99 > baseline + 45% for 5m OR error-rate >0.8% for 3m. manual fallback route to helix-v1.3 in ops playbook and a per-tenant mute flag if needed.
Samira: rollout plan?
Evan: 12% -> 30% in 2h -> 60% in 8h -> 100% in 36h if green. GA target in ~11 days after bench write-up and tenant smoke tests.
Leo: please prep a single-slide before/after and add the mute-flag snippet to the ops playbook. I'll take a one-liner for execs once we hit full rollout.
Evan: exec blurb draft: "Helix-prefetcher v1.4 cut median short-chat latency ~28% and improved tail metrics, lowering unit inference cost by ~11% in early canary; staged rollout underway."
Samira: thanks team  leaving canary watch on, ping this thread for urgent alerts.
